players.bio: Alfonso González Martínez (born 4 May 1999), commonly known as Alfon, is a Spanish professional footballer who plays mainly as a left winger for La Liga club Sevilla.

Andrés López Gallo (born 26 May 2003), known as Andrés Castrín or just Castrín, is a Spanish footballer who plays as a central defender for Sevilla. Club career Born in Riotorto, Lugo, Galicia, Castrín played for ED Lourenzá, CD Lugo and Racing Club Villalbés as a youth. In 2021, after finishing his formation, he was assigned to Lugo's farm team Polvorín FC in the Tercera División RFEF.

Arouna Sangante (born 12 April 2002) is a Senegalese professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for and captains Le Havre. Club career Arouna Sangante played for Cosmos Saint-Denis and Red Star in Île-de-France, before joining Le Havre in 2017. He made his Ligue 2 debut for Le Havre on the 15 May 2021, starting the game against the league champions of Troyes.

César Azpilicueta Tanco (born 28 August 1989) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a full-back or centre-back for La Liga club Sevilla. A youth product of Osasuna, Azpilicueta spent three seasons in La Liga before switching to Marseille, winning four major honours with the French club.
Chidera Ejuke (born 2 January 1998) is a Nigerian professional footballer who plays as a winger for La Liga club Sevilla and the Nigeria national team.

Fábio Rafael Rodrigues Cardoso (born 19 April 1994) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for La Liga club Sevilla. Formed at Benfica, where he played only in the reserves, he made over 150 Primeira Liga appearances for Paços de Ferreira, Vitória Setúbal, Santa Clara and Porto. Abroad, he had a brief spell in the Scottish Premiership with Rangers.
Félix Alexandre Andrade Sanches Correia (born 22 January 2001) is a Portuguese professional footballer who plays as a winger for La Liga club Sevilla, on loan from Ligue 1 club Lille.
Francisco Javier González Pérez (born 24 June 2005) is a Spanish footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for Real Madrid.

Gabriel Alonso Suazo Urbina (born 9 August 1997) is a Chilean professional footballer who plays as a left-back or midfielder for La Liga club Sevilla and the Chile national team. International career Suazo was called up for Chile's pre-Copa América Centenario friendly against Mexico in May 2016.
Giorgi Kochorashvili (born 29 June 1999) is a Georgian professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for Portuguese club Sporting CP and the Georgia national team.
Isaac Romero Bernal (born 16 April 2000) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a forward for Sevilla.
Joan Jordán Moreno (born 6 July 1994) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a central midfielder for La Liga club Sevilla.
Jon Guridi Aldalur (born 28 February 1995) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays for La Liga club Alavés. Often deployed as a midfielder, he can also play as a right-back or right wing-back.
José Ángel Carmona Navarro (born 29 January 2002) is a Spanish professional footballer for La Liga club Sevilla. Mainly a right-back and right wing-back, he can also play as an centre-back.
Juan Antonio Iglesias Sánchez (born 3 July 1998) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays for Getafe CF. Mainly a right-back, he can also play as a right winger.
Enrique Jesús "Kike" Salas Valiente (born 23 April 2002) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a central defender for La Liga club Sevilla.
Lucien Jefferson Agoumé (born 9 February 2002) is a French professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Sevilla. Agoumé is a supporter of Marseille.
Luis García Plaza (born 1 December 1972) is a Spanish former professional footballer who played as a right-back or a central defender. He is the current manager of La Liga club Sevilla.
Manuel "Manu" Bueno Sebastián (born 27 July 2004) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for Sevilla Atlético.
Marcos do Nascimento Teixeira (born 5 June 1996), commonly known as Marcão, is a Brazilian professional footballer who plays as a centre-back for La Liga club Sevilla.
Miguel Ángel Sierra Ortega (born 14 July 2004) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a left winger for Sevilla FC.
Odysseas Vlachodimos is a professional footballer who plays as a goalkeeper for La Liga club Sevilla, on loan from Premier League club Newcastle United.
Gerard "Peque" Fernández Castellano (born 4 October 2002) is a Spanish professional footballer who plays as a forward for La Liga club Sevilla.
Robert Philip Thomas Ure (born 24 February 2004) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a striker for La Liga club Sevilla.
Robert Philip Thomas Ure (born 24 February 2004) is a Scottish professional footballer who plays as a striker for La Liga club Sevilla.

Rubén Estephan Vargas Martínez (born 5 August 1998) is a Swiss professional footballer who plays as a winger or attacking midfielder for Spanish La Liga club Sevilla and the Switzerland national team.
Youssouf Fofana (born 10 January 1999) is a French professional footballer who plays as a midfielder for AC Milan.
